source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 12.11.2, printed page 283.

blocks.text: Sulfur paudon ki barhotri ke liye zaroori ghiza hai. Jab mitti mein sulfate kam ho jaye to sulfur wale N/P fertilisers ya sulfur-coated urea jaise sulfur-coated fertilisers dal kar sulfur bahal ki jati hai; mitti ke ajza aur microbes element sulfur ko paudon ke liye halne wali shaklon mein badalte hain. Gypsum (CaSO4.2H2O; print mein 5H2O) bhi fertiliser ke taur par istemal hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Element sulfur khet mein kyun dali ja sakti hai halanke paude sulfur sirf sulfate ke taur par lete hain?
blocks.explanation: Mitti ke microbes aur mitti ki chemistry element sulfur ko aahista sulfate mein oxidise karte hain, to sulfur-coated dane aahista chhorne wala zariya bante hain jo fasal ki zaroorat ke mutabiq sulfate deta rehta hai.

items: Sulfur paudon ki zaroori ghiza hai; S wale N/P fertilisers, sulfur-coated urea (microbes S ko sulfate mein oxidise karte hain) ya gypsum se bahal.
